#!/usr/bin/env sh
# Gradle wrapper script (thin script). Ensure gradle-wrapper.jar exists in gradle/wrapper.
set -e
PRG="$0"
while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
  ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
  link=`expr "$ls" : '.*-> \(.*\)$'`
  if expr "$link" : '/.*' > /dev/null; then
    PRG="$link"
  else
    PRG=`dirname "$PRG"`"/$link"
  fi
done
PRGDIR=`dirname "$PRG"`
exec "$PRGDIR/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" "$@"
